quest.title: Controllable Explosion
quest.description: The testing on the "Remelting Tablets" is progressing smoothly. It is time to report back to Hajanad...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Unknown Item #363323 x1

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: You're back! Ah, I've waited here for so long!

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: Come, tell me how the "Remelting Tablets" did in detail.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hajanad seems excited.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then we'll start with the shortcomings first! Clench your teeth!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You describe the pros and cons of "Remelting Tablets" to Hajanad in detail.

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: I see... I understand now.

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: The current explosion is not accurate enough to control the exact potion mix, so the effects can be unstable.

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: What I need to do is to make a shield for the explosive, focus the resultant shockwave, and also modify the arrangement of preset tablets...

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: Yes, it won't take long to make these modifications. The problem is funding...

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: Fortunately, I still have my emergency funds! It should be enough if I sell the old equipment and eat once a day from now on.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're going to eat only once a day?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, no! That's unacceptable! Why didn't you mention that you don't have enough funds?

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: Oh, rest assured. Your payment is guaranteed. I had it all budgeted out.

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: I'm used to eating once a day by now. Sometimes I only have three meals in a week, so this shouldn't be a problem.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't have to try so hard...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now Paimon's really curious...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why do you want to become a famous researcher so bad, Ms. Hajanad?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you really that into academic research? Do you want to prove your worth by doing this? Or are you planning to make a lot of Mora with alchemy?

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: This is so out of the blue that I'm not sure either... Maybe it's just because I was bullied in the past that I got obsessed.

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: If I can prove my worth, then I can live a better life.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So you're doing this for that reason...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So that's why you started to do academic research?

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: Yes. Knowledge is everything in this country, and so the only way up is through one's academic abilities.

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: I don't have much talent or high intellect, so my breakthroughs are limited to unpopular subjects that no one wants to take up.

dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: I've been delving into my research for so long that I forgot how to act around people. Perhaps my temper's suffered for it too...

choices.text: Most people out there are good folks.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! You already have an impressive goal now. You should try to enjoy your life!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If you keep a normal heart and make normal conversations with people, there will definitely be those who'd like to help you with your research!

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: I know, I know. Still, thank you for the advice.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: I realized that it's much easier and more interesting to study alchemy compared to studying what to eat or what to say to others.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: But since I've met you guys, I've been doing some self-reflection, and I believe that I should really work on my emotions and expressions.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Anyway, thanks for helping me test out the "Remelting Tablets." I should go back and write my papers now.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: In addition to the promised payment, this, too, is for you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What is this?

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: My best alchemy cauldron. It cost me a great deal back then, but I treasured it so much that I never got the chance to use it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Why are you suddenly giving up your most precious tool?

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: "Remelting Tablets" are different from traditional potions. They need the equipment I newly designed to produce them, so I won't be using this cauldron anyway.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: I did also make a promise to you, after all. Let this be a keepsake of that promise.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: You can try using it to make... tea or soup, I guess? Whatever comes out of it should taste better due to its extraordinary extraction functions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since you put it that way... It would be rude of us to refuse you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You can do this, Hajanad!

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Of course! Just you wait!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Hajanad leaves.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Say, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We did a good deed this time, right?

choices.text: Just another day in our adventures.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right... It's too early for us to come to any conclusions just yet.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Maybe a day will come when we'll have forgotten about this event and boom! Hajanad suddenly becomes a famous researcher and invites us to visit her!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, enough of that! Let's go and make some tea with this alchemy cauldron!

choices.text: We should steady our hearts as well.
